title: Sparkly paper plane
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Paper plane body -->
  <polygon points="15,55 85,20 55,65" fill="#7EC8F0" stroke="#A8DDF5" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <polygon points="15,55 55,65 40,70" fill="#4A9FD4" stroke="#7EC8F0" stroke-width="1"/>
  <polygon points="55,65 85,20 75,50" fill="#5AB0E8" stroke="#A8DDF5" stroke-width="1"/>
  <!-- Fold line -->
  <line x1="55" y1="65" x2="85" y2="20" stroke="#C8EEFF" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <line x1="55" y1="65" x2="15" y2="55" stroke="#C8EEFF" stroke-width="1"/>
  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <g fill="#FFE94A" stroke="#FFF5A0" stroke-width="0.5">
    <!-- Big sparkle top-left -->
    <polygon points="20,25 23,32 30,35 23,38 20,45 17,38 10,35 17,32" />
    <!-- Sparkle top-right -->
    <polygon points="78,12 80,17 85,19 80,21 78,26 76,21 71,19 76,17" />
    <!-- Small sparkle middle -->
    <polygon points="88,40 89,43 92,44 89,45 88,48 87,45 84,44 87,43" />
    <!-- Sparkle bottom -->
    <polygon points="40,82 42,86 46,88 42,90 40,94 38,90 34,88 38,86" />
    <!-- Tiny sparkle left -->
    <polygon points="8,65 9,68 12,69 9,70 8,73 7,70 4,69 7,68" />
    <!-- Sparkle bottom right -->
    <polygon points="72,75 74,79 78,81 74,83 72,87 70,83 66,81 70,79" />
    <!-- Extra tiny sparkles -->
    <circle cx="50" cy="30" r="1.5" fill="#FFE94A"/>
    <circle cx="30" cy="75" r="1.2" fill="#FFF5A0"/>
    <circle cx="90" cy="60" r="1.3" fill="#FFE94A"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Motion lines -->
  <line x1="10" y1="60" x2="2" y2="65" stroke="#A8DDF5" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="12" y1="50" x2="4" y2="52" stroke="#A8DDF5" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="14" y1="68" x2="6" y2="72" stroke="#A8DDF5" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
